critical_code_review_comments: AdminMockedScreens.jsx ProvisionForm still contains the hard-coded 'noVNC Console (mock)' JSX (lines ~194-210) behind the withConsole prop. Not invoked anywhere in the current tab dispatch, so it is unreachable dead code - safe to DELETE completely to guarantee no future accidental exposure of the mock.

context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter36_prod_readiness.py is idempotent and covers all iter36 acceptance criteria. UI selectors for provisioning: use button:has-text('cPanel/WHM')/button:has-text('Proxmox VE') for tabs, then data-testid=prov-username/prov-domain/prov-plan/prov-password (cpanel) or prov-hostname + os-* (proxmox), then data-testid=prov-submit. Success banner is prov-hosting-ok/prov-proxmox-ok (should never appear until real integrations configured). Users page has BOTH a top search input AND a New user modal - target modal inputs specifically (e.g. within [role=dialog]) to avoid filling the search box. Login field is 'token' (not 'access_token') on /api/portal/auth/login.
